list.label: Trace ID
list.description: Paste a trace ID from pipelines-overview.json's recent-flow-runs table, or arrive here via that table's built-in trace link.

panels.title: Flow waterfall - one row per stage, expand for steps
panels.description: Flat trace shape by design: every stage (build/test/deploy/release) parents directly to the flow root, not to the previous stage, because stages don't overlap in time - nesting them would misrepresent duration. See docs/tracing.md. Spans carrying governance.stub=true (see catalog/stepactions/governance-stub.yaml) render distinctly below - never mistake a stub gate for a real enforcement result here.

panels.title: Governance gates in this run - stub vs real
panels.description: Any row with governance.stub=true is not a real check result - see docs/governance-stubs.md. This is the platform's structural, loud fix for the old system's silently-always-passing exit-0 gates.

panels.title: Step logs for this trace
panels.description: See observability/loki/values.yaml 'KNOWN GAP' note - trace-to-logs correlation is provisioned ahead of raw stdout log shipping actually landing. Until that lands, this panel will be empty for most steps.
